title: Managed Database: current primary billing review — approved node price selection
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database current primary billing review uses the following approved node price selection basis. Use the approved negotiated unit price when negotiated price approval is approved; otherwise use the standard tier unit price. No further discount applies to an approved negotiated price.

## Rate selection
| Negotiated-price approval | Selected node price |
|---|---|
| Approved | The approved negotiated unit price, without another discount |
| Otherwise | The standard tier unit price |
